title: Radcliffe and Maconie
description: Mark and Stuart present a feast of music, plus writer and broadcaster Danny Robins shares his 'First, Last and Everything' and chats about his new BBC drama series 'The Witch Farm.'.

title: The Beth Ditto Show
description: Beth brightens up your Saturday with a healthy dose of tunes, laughs and caffeine.

title: Jamz Supernova
description: Jamz marks 25 years of grime with Sir Spyro, Nolay, Jayahadadream, Dread D, Tim & Barry TV, The Grime Journalist & Dametalmessiah. They trace grime from inception to the future..

title: Zakia Sewell
description: Zakia selects music from Brazil, Denmark and Zambia. Plus, a special Label Focus on Brighton's eclectic Hive Mind Records with its founder, Mark Teare.

title: The Craig Charles Funk and Soul Show
description: Deptford Northern Soul Club are taking over this week's Trunk of Funk. Expect a crate full of floor-fillers as they celebrate ten years of keeping the faith.

title: Don Letts' Culture Clash Radio
description: Don's Saturday night selections cross time, space and genre. This week, he's got cuts by the likes of Clancy Eccles, Billy Nomates, Thee Marloes, Donovan and Sampa The Great.

title: SHERELLE
description: SHERELLE soundtracks your Saturday night with footwork, baile funk, electro and more. This show features shakers from Kelela, Mr. Ho, DJ Taz and Yaeji.

title: The Sweatbox
description: The genre-hopping party starter BAMBII takes over the Sweatbox with a wild 30 minutes of original material, edits, twists and turns.

title: 6 Music's Rave Forever
description: As 6 Music Goes Dark we celebrate two decades of Skream's seminal debut album with a deep dive into the darkest, moodiest dubstep 2006 had to offer.

title: The Morning After Mix
description: Two hours of calm, hand-picked gems from new artists and old favourites, including SAULT, Radiohead and Kate Bush.

title: The Morning After Mix
description: Have yourself a very chilled Christmas with two hours of laid-back alternative music for the festive season. With tracks from Sufjan Stevens, Goldfrapp, Low, Marvin Gaye and more.

title: AFRODEUTSCHE
description: AFRODEUTSCHE eases you into Sunday morning on 6 Music with an immaculate blend of soulful gems, lo-fi beats, and classic tunes.

title: Radcliffe and Maconie
description: Mark and Stuart present a feast of great music and chat for weekend breakfast.

title: Cerys Matthews
description: Cerys welcomes Andrew Roachford to explore the vocal effects that inspired Cher's 'Believe', and chef Calum Franklin takes us on a delicious journey around Britain in pies.

title: Guy Garvey's Finest Hour
description: Guy's back - and talking to Kate Stables of This is the Kit about music, French geography, superstitions and Ursula K. Le Guin.

title: Jarvis Cocker
description: Jarvis tests his inherited copy of Revolver by The Beatles on the BBC record decks. He also charts some chart action for November 29th including Van Morrison and ABBA.

title: Mary Anne Hobbs
description: Mary Anne's favourite drummer and percussionist Valentina Magaletti selects for the End of Days music library. There's also a world premier of new music from Scotch Rolex.

title: Stuart Maconie's Freak Zone
description: Stuart takes you back to your childhood with Sandra Kerr and John Faulkner's music from Bagpuss.

title: Dream Time
description: Zakia indulges her seasonal melancholy with lots of folk guitars, plus a special Dreambience mix from the unreleased archives of Bibio & Dorian Concept.
